card.intuition: A working pattern where the user kicks off a session and the agent runs unattended, letting many sessions run in parallel while they sleep, eat, or work on something else. Ambiguity left unstated becomes a silent default the agent commits to, and every later decision builds on that guess. Safe AFK needs a permissive permission mode, sandboxing, automated checks, and an end state that is reviewable, like a PR rather than merged changes.
card.analogy: Like handing the night shift to a team of careful but literal interns: they execute exactly the instructions they have, and every gap in the instructions gets filled with their own guess while nobody is around to question it.
card.time_complexity: Operational cost is throughput-bound: many AFK sessions run in parallel, but each agent call still adds inference cost, and deferring review to the end adds latency before a human can respond.
card.space_complexity: Context footprint grows with run length: an agent working for hours accumulates the whole journey in the context window, risking attention degradation or compaction that drops early decisions.
when_to_use: Many independent tasks that benefit from parallel unattended sessions
Runs that end in a reviewable PR or artifact rather than in merged changes
gotchas: The characteristic failure is hours of confident work built on a wrong call made in the first ten minutes
Without a permissive permission mode and sandboxing, unattended runs are unsafe
AFK defers human review to the end, so what arrives has to be worth reviewing

steps.label: Kick off
steps.annotation: The user starts the session and walks away.

steps.label: Defaults
steps.annotation: Unanswered decisions turn into defaults the agent keeps building on.

steps.label: Self-correct
steps.annotation: Deterministic checks catch mechanical failures while nobody watches.

steps.label: Reviewable end
steps.annotation: The run ends in a diff a human can review, never in merged changes.

steps.label: Review
steps.annotation: Deferred human review finally arrives, so the artifact must be worth it.

exercise.prompt: Model an unattended run: items that did not pass automated checks go to a queue for deferred human review.
hints: Unattended work defers judgement to the end of the run.
Items that did not pass automatically still need a human reviewer.
